purpose: Controlled post-exec RSS attribution; separate diagnostic runs
measurement: Post-exec status every20ms; smaps_rollup/full smaps every100ms. Executable on tmpfs may contribute RssShmem; executable mapping breakdown retained.
limitations: Proc RSS counters are asynchronous and approximate; smaps samples are diagnostic observations.
Diagnostic read overhead and PERF_METRICS runs are excluded from acceptance timings.
Same artifact files reused within this diagnostic cohort; fresh-copy experiment if warranted.
